title: The substrate cannot author a change to any file outside repos/<vessel>/src, because both delivery paths require that pr
description: The substrate cannot author a change to any file outside repos/<vessel>/src, because both delivery paths require that prefix - so a defect whose fix lives in .gitignore, a script, or any super-repo root file is structurally undeliverable by the system. Edit repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/gap-to-feature.ts.
